evidence.quote: This is my first choice. I am seriously considering it, but I want to understand the basement seepage before deciding.
A two-car garage is a must. Keep the search at two or more.
This is second. I could handle cosmetic kitchen changes, but the one-car garage does not work.
I noticed Morgan spent more time in the kitchen at Example Ridge.
I wonder if outdoor space matters more than Morgan has said; I need to ask.
Morgan agreed I should request the seepage and repair records. No deadline was agreed.
